style: Single complete enemy sprite for the Japanese lantern dungeon RPG bestiary and battle screen. Use the attached three small examples exclusively as references for the same intricate game ink outlines, painterly bone highlights and weathered iron, muted parchment palette and dark cavities; match their readable body proportions and shading. Draw only the described NEW monster. Three-quarter view, readable when displayed at 120 pixels. The entire figure, gear, tips of feet and limbs are comfortably inside the square with transparent padding on all sides. Genuine clean alpha around and through the anatomy. Isolated on a fully transparent background. Upper-left light. Only the monster and its attached or specified equipment appear. No ground, shadows on ground, background glow, border, lettering, frames or captions.

guard_2.prompt: Salt mine labyrinth beast. A small low-slung skeletal tunneling badger, stocky mammal skull, wedge-shaped muzzle, huge digging foreclaws, hunched spine carrying angular off-white rock-salt cubes, ochre earth trapped between the bones. Wide scuttling stance in three-quarter view facing left.

guard_2_elite.prompt: Salt mine guardian. A massive upright, stooped skeletal pit ape, a broad rib cage plated with angular pale lilac salt crystals, long knuckle-walking arms planted apart, compact primate skull with two amber glints deep in the sockets. One shoulder higher than the other, a short loop of old mine chain at the wrist. Squared imposing silhouette.

battlefield_bonebeast.prompt: Battlefield bone beast. A running skeletal war hound caught in a low spring, a long canine skull with bared fangs and two droplets of dull green venom, narrow waist, whipping vertebral tail, strips of faded crimson military harness caught in the ribs. All four legs are canine, distinct, paws visible. Strong sweeping horizontal silhouette, faces left.

kagaribi_ash_guard.prompt: Red-rust sentry. Upright human skeleton peering out from under a corroded kettle helm with one chipped brim, battered rounds of red-rust scale armor, one fist resting on the pommel of a wide rusty sword with its tip planted at the feet. Other arm braces a small round buckler, exposed bone shins. Stern watch at a doorway, sturdy compact triangular silhouette.

kagaribi_chain_bone.prompt: Chain-dragging skeleton in the shallows. A wiry bare human skeleton leans sharply backward, heels dug in, both hands hauling a thick black iron chain taut on a diagonal to one single broken anchor fluke lying near the feet, the entire anchor fluke and chain fit inside the picture. Torn indigo waist sash. Its own body is unarmored; strong diagonal tugging pose, body, feet and anchor legible as one unit.

kagaribi_patrol_guard.prompt: Patrol-route rust sentry. Tall lean striding skeletal watchman with a crooked red iron visor and belted short brigandine. Carries a long forked watch spear upright and lifts a caged amber patrol lantern out in front, warm glow confined to the lantern. Mid-stride facing left, exposed skeletal knees. Instantly recognizable tall silhouette dominated by spear and lantern.

kagaribi_ossuary_bone.prompt: Ossuary chain bearer. A short broad humpbacked skeleton, shoulders buried under a heavy iron chain yoke and a single large hanging funerary censer. The chain forms a tall arch over its skull; a low copper censer at its side carries muted verdigris, a few ivory burial tags tied to its links. It stoops forward and lifts the censer by the chain with both hands, a coherent full figure facing left.

kagaribi_ossuary_remnant.prompt: Ossuary fallen soldier. A broken skeletal foot soldier sitting low on its shattered pelvis in a tattered desaturated burgundy tabard; one leg extends, the other is splintered at the shin. It props its torso up with a jagged split coffin-lid shield held vertically and clutches a short snapped blade in the other hand. Tilted skull looks towards the foe. Intact distinct low silhouette, determined posture, sparse broken bones beside its own body.
